designationHistory.indexText: Residence Act of July 16, 1790 authorized the federal district and public buildings from which the Mall's public grounds derive

sources.name: The National Parks: Index 2012–2016 (National Park Service), PDF page 44
Statutes at Large (govinfo): Act of July 16, 1790, ch. 28, 1 Stat. 130, An Act for establishing the temporary and permanent seat of the Government of the United States, approved July 16, 1790

review.note: Date, act and President (Washington) are right, but the Residence Act does not mention a mall: it set the permanent seat of government and authorized commissioners to provide public buildings. The Mall comes from the L'Enfant plan of 1791. Text softened accordingly.
review.by: HistorianPanel accuracy review, batch 5c (National Park System)
